Bimbo Steph & Lydia.[/i][/p][p][i]Along with new story content![/i][/p][p][i]Updates the engine to Ren'Py 7.8.4 which should fix the issues Mac users were having.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]I've tested through this many times and fixed any bugs reported during the BETA, I'll be double checking them all and if I have missed any, fixing them for v.0.17.1.[/p][p][/p][p]I've also played through all the paths and everything seems to be running smoothly, but there's so many variables in the game my save files do not cover them all, so if you do get any bugs please report them via Discord.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What's Next?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]There will be another update in about a week's time (v.0.17.1) changing a lot of coding to do with the computer, which I am almost finished with, adding in the new achievements, adding in a Tiffany gallery page, and implementing the in-game walkthrough.[/p][p][/p][p]I couldn't fully implement the in-game walkthrough without messing with the in-game computer and it just put bugs everywhere with the custom UI screen I made, so I'm going to remove the one selection screen where you click the people for the missions and take it to a standard Ren'Py choice screen that I can add the walkthrough to.[/p][p][/p][p]I'll also be adding in some custom audio for the builders, train and tunnel with v.0.17.1 to polish the update off, but all the new renders and content for this update is now there.[/p][p][/p][p][b]I hope you all enjoy the update, and thanks for all the new and continued support![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]WP[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Defending Lydia Collier Development Log
notes.content:
[h1]Defending Lydia Collier Development Log[/h1]

[b]Hello everybody![/b]

As many of you will know, sadly I suffered quite severe burns on my hands with renovating the place to use as a new dedicated office, which put me in hospital requiring a lot of the skin on both my hands to be cut off. Even with the smaller dressings after the initial, essentially mittens, were removed, it ended up being a lot harder than expected to work and almost impossible to use a keyboard and mouse.

I apologise for this and the lack of posting, I am a solo developer, hence why nothing was being posted, and the time away wasn't pleasant time for myself either. However, the good news is now the dressings are off completely and my hands are, almost, as good as new!

I've used the time to fully plan out all the endings and final updates of Defending Lydia Collier, and here's some previews of what is coming so far!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43138987/87813a918d5a06a904d99af814075eb9315291bc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43138987/cdf63c6fc04a336a4754c7174286a53c3a4d7a5e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43138987/7dc83e3aa2b95a45f45e44752a064d2a58841af2.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43138987/94803490e322c27eddc11b72487dd6220ee0b26d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43138987/9c2f884df1629da4b4f06f5bf05782865d2fd834.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43138987/fb1a45b6de41c8e528dec368a880fd615a856e07.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43138987/582947aef8a23921342e374bd13aa0cdb62fb4e4.jpg[/img]

The next update will be the first half of Monday, advancing all the paths with some story and relationship scenes throughout the day, and then a second update will follow that with some purely relationship based scenes before the game's story finale and epilogue.

I'll be going back to weekly development logs now, so check back here for more previews and the latest progress as was before.

[b]Thanks for all the patience and new and continued support!

WP[/b]

notes.title: Defending Lydia Collier v.0.16.2 Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43138987/8b8055cd376e5680a3bce938fbd735997efeda36.jpg[/img]
[h1]Defending Lydia Collier v.0.16.2 Released![/h1]

Hello everybody, here is the latest update of Defending Lydia Collier.

[u]Change Log:[/u]

[i]Multiple bug fixes for typos and errors.

Recodes the gallery, which should fix the errors some people encountered of the gallery relocking itself with v.0.16.1.

New pictures for Ellie on Sunday if she went with Lydia, fixing her being in the wrong place during Emma's scene.

Adds in Stephanie's Hard Drive, fulfilling a long term promise to add this in to those who requested it.[/i]

[u]Note on updating the Official Walkthrough:[/u]

[i]I've been trying to update the walkthrough, however I have made an amateur mistake and in the year or so since I've touched it I have lost the original InDesign File and I do not have a backup.

I've tried editing it and adding bits on, but it looks really poor, especially as an "Official Walkthrough".

Because of this I'm currently redoing the entire walkthrough and this will be released on it's own once it is completed in the next couple of days.[/i]

[u]Note on Stephanie's Hard Drive:[/u]

[i]This contains some very distressing content and it is recommend you destroy it without viewing it.[/i]

[u]What's Next:[/u]

Once the walkthrough has been remade I'll then be working on Monday in-game, which will advance the story for all paths.

[b]Thanks for all the new and continued support!

WP[/b]

notes.title: Defending Lydia Collier v.0.16.1 Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43138987/792438463f3f67ff1829978170182e26502b98b9.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Defending Lydia Collier v.0.16.1 Released![/b][/h1]

Thank you all for your patience, here is the latest update of Defending Lydia Collier and as long awaited, Achievements!

This is the first thing I've ever released on Steam, and I self publish so getting these working has been a bit tricky. I believe the Steam Achievements are now all working, but if you find any that are not then please use Discord (link in the game's menu) to let me know.

For Achievements, please start a new game! They are not retroactive.

This update also adds in new content for Tiffany, Vanessa and Sophie, returning everybody to the UK so that I can focus on the next big day in the story instead of small updates for individual characters.

[b]Change Log:[/b]

[i]Adds in 54 Achievements to the game, each with a corresponding unlockable image!

Adds in new content with Tiffany, Sophie and Vanessa, totally just over 500 renders, including Tiffany's phone and the group's return from the island.

Many bug fixes and quality of life changes to the earlier days to make the game more replayable and the computer less intrusive, this include persistent flags for finding information on the PC, and warnings when a choice will take you off a character's path.

Adds in missing content with Stephanie on Sunday and during the motorway stop if you've dated her before.[/i]

Stephanie's hard drive and the walkthrough will be added and updated very shortly.

[b]Thanks for all the new and continued support!

WP[/b]

notes.title: Defending Lydia Collier v.0.16 Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43138987/285e9322512b93755fdacf0e7855ea338098dfa2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Defending Lydia Collier v.0.16 Update Release![/h1]

[h2]This update adds in the final new scene of Sunday, featuring Lydia and Ellie![/h2]

[b]Change Log:[/b]

[i]Adds in 244 new renders featuring Lydia and Ellie.

Fixes multiple typos and dialogue errors.

Fixes Vanessa's 5th scene in the Replay Gallery.[/i]

[u]Why v.0.16 and not v.0.15.10?[/u]

All of the renders and scenes for Sunday are now done!

Whilst I am still working on the coding/computer technical updates, I will now be working on new scenes, renders and content for v.0.17 to keep the game advancing.

Technical updates will be just be a ".x" onto whatever current version we're on, and not a specific number for themselves.

Now I'm going to be working on Monday in the game, keep an eye on X (Twitter) and Discord for previews!

[b]Thanks for all the new and continued support!

WP[/b]

notes.title: v.0.15.2 - Bug Fix Patch
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/fMXF8wq/stephmechanic.jpg[/img]

[h1]Minor update fixing several bugs.[/h1]

[b]Saves made with errors, typically caused by ignoring a Ren'Py Error, continuing with the game and then saving with the game in an error state, will now open a bug screen to prevent the save being used.[/b]

[i]I appreciate this may be irritating if you didn't know you had saved the game in an error state, however this is the cause all of the "NoneType" and "VPGrill Full" errors that have been popping up and was necessary to prevent future crashes and bugs. If you do encounter a Ren'Py Error, you must roll back and save before it, ignoring it and continuing will cause bugs down the line.[/i]

[b]Removed the "voice" slider from the options as it was redundant and the other sliders control all audio.[/b]

[b]Fixed errors in the Quick Save Menu Buttons.[/b]
